name: AgendaWeb Cultural Protocol
description: Decentralized cultural calendar, live music venue directory, and RSS syndication server for Australia (Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart).

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Fetch upcoming live concerts, arts exhibitions, and community gigs across Melbourne and Australian hubs with filtering by city, category, and age rating.

city.description: Metropolitan city slug (melbourne, sydney, brisbane, perth, adelaide, hobart, or all)

category.description: Event category filter (e.g. Live Music, Culture, Community, or all)

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-50)

tools.name: get_venues
tools.description: Query directory of independent Australian live music venues, cultural halls, addresses, and age policies.

tools.name: get_calendar_feed
tools.description: Get standard RFC 5545 iCalendar (.ics) synchronization URL for adding events to calendar applications.

venue.description: Specific venue slug, or 'all' for full city lineup
